newsitem.title: USA: CIGNA completes tender for Healthsource.
newsitem.headline: CIGNA completes tender for Healthsource.

text.p: CIGNA Corp said Thursday its subsidiary CHC Acquisition Corp had completed its $21.75 per share cash tender offer for the outstanding common stock of Healthsource Inc.
CIGNA said 63.3 million shares of Healthsource had been tendered as of the close of the offer on June 25, including 1.1 million shares tendered pursuant to notices of guaranteed delivery.
The shares tendered equal about 98 percent of Healthsource's outstanding common stock, it said.
By the deadline, about one million shares had not been tendered.
Holders of Healthsource common stock who did not tender will be entitled to $21.75 per share in cash following completion of the merger.
The deal should close promptly, CIGNA said.
CIGNA agreed in February to acquire Healthsource for about $1.7 billion, including repayment of $250 million of Healthsource long-term debt.
